can_establish: Whether same-binary owned-reader pair excursions recur at comparable frequency or magnitude.
Whether excursions are route-specific, pair-position-specific, or associated with first/second label order.
Whether total p50 differences track preparation, open, query, edit, commit, or publication phase differences.
A descriptive null distribution for whole-child RSS under the retained binary and fixed protocol.
cannot_establish: That a prior candidate caused or did not cause a reader p50/RSS regression.
A causal attribution to ASLR, allocator arenas, page faults, scheduler/frequency drift, or reader/parser code.
Phase-local RSS: current normal RSS is a whole-child maximum including warmups, checks and JSON serialization.
A population-wide performance claim, a production quality pass, threshold relaxation, or retroactive adoption.

harness_boundaries.finding: expected package/oracle, output, payload ranges and optional staged file are prepared before the sample loop
preparation timing includes per-sample source Vec cloning, observer/adapter/sink setup and owned-reader input preparation
open, query, edit, commit and publication are separate timed phases; owned-reader construction and Package::from_reader are in open
provider snapshots and correctness/reopen/inverse/digest/source checks follow publication and are outside timed phases
measured vectors are stored in elapsed-rank order while sample_order retains original sample indices; chronological analysis requires reconstructing with that permutation and was not performed here
JSON report serialization occurs after the workload; whole-child time/RSS still includes it when wrapped by the runner
one fresh subprocess is launched per child; terminal RSS is whole-process and the report path is outside phase timing

interpretation_guardrails: Verify identical binary SHA, retained source revision, corpus/output hashes, environment, compiler/profile and CPU affinity for every child; route selector is the intended route difference.
Use equal-length report paths on the same filesystem because report writing is outside phase timing but inside whole-child RSS/time.
Pair all 12 fixed pairs per route, preserve every terminal/noisy child, and never retry or replace a child after observing its result.
Use neutral symmetric A/A ratios or log-ratios; do not label either run baseline/candidate or apply the production improvement gate.

Report total and all six phases, both pair directions, child position, and elapsed-rank/sample_order metadata; chronological within-child analysis requires reconstructing with sample_order and was not performed here.
State that warmups and measured samples share one child process and allocator; process isolation is child-level, not fresh-process-per-sample.
Treat a same-binary reader flag as evidence of protocol/host variability consistent with the null, not proof of harmlessness; absence of a flag does not prove prior candidate causality.
